# AWS (Amazon EKS)

This directory contains all AWS-specific code for deploying an EKS cluster with Kasten K10 data protection.

* [k8s-tf/](./k8s-tf): Terraform code to provision an EKS cluster, VPC, S3, IAM, Secrets Manager, and optionally bootstrap ArgoCD with GitOps-managed applications.
* [argocd/](./argocd): ArgoCD application and addon manifests. The majority of these files are auto-generated by Terraform.
